commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Pierre Gaillouste has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+2' 1 - 3 Goal! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Adrien Lebeau, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Hugo Magnetti is replaced by Adrien Lebeau (Brest).
88' Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
86' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

83' A cross is whipped in towards Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
82' A substitution has been made. Joris Chotard is replaced by Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier).
80' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
78' Steve Mounie (Brest) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
76' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
75' That will be all from Romain Del Castillo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
73' The Brest players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
71' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Brest! Play can continue.

70' Play continues despite the shouts by some Brest players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Pierre Gaillouste interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
70' PENALTY APPEAL after Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
68' 50:50 – the ratio of ball possession.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Khalil Fayad will be replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
64' 1 - 2 It's 1:2! Steve Mounie feeds Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
63' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) replaces Jeremy Le Douaron.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Satriano leaves the pitch and Steve Mounie (Brest) comes on.
62' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brest.

61' Akor Adams (Montpellier) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
59' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
59' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) works the corner short.
59' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. Good work from Montpellier as they win a corner.

58' My Gran could have done better! Kenny Lala (Brest) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
56' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:1.
53' Neat passing move from Montpellier in order to create new attacking opportunities.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Marco Bizot.
50' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
50' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) jumps into a tackle and Pierre Gaillouste signals a foul. Montpellier are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
49' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
47' Montpellier control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
41' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benjamin Lecomte intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Brest will have an opportunity.
38' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Benjamin Lecomte is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
34' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Kenny Lala (Brest) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

30' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
30' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
30' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' The current number of corner kicks is 3:0.
27' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
27' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
26' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' This is a yellow card! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
24' Brest enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' 0 - 1 Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is totally disorientated and accidentally puts the ball into his own goal!
19' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Bradley Locko (Brest) touches the ball with his hand.
14' Montpellier are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
12' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
9' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
8' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.
5' Great teamplay by Montpellier as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
